info.title: Silvervibe API
info.description: HTTP API for Silvervibe apps and product add-ons.

bearer.description: Firebase ID token. Outside production, when Admin is unset: Bearer dev:<uid>.

enabled.description: true = grant / keep entitlement; false = revoke

userId.description: Firebase UID or existing Neon user id

acceptPath.description: Relative path for the invitee to open after sign-in

member.description: Set when the invitee was added immediately (already a user)

emailSent.description: True when an invite email was sent via Resend for this response

emailError.description: Resend error message when emailSent is false after a send attempt

configured.description: True when a bot token or legacy Incoming Webhook is stored (secret never returned)

authMode.description: oauth | webhook when configured; null when disconnected

toolEnabled.description: Whether workspace tool entitlement addons.slack is enabled

oauthAvailable.description: True when SLACK_CLIENT_ID / SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET are set

authorizeUrl.description: Slack OAuth authorize URL to open in the browser

configured.description: True when OAuth tokens or a legacy Incoming Webhook are stored (secret never returned)

authMode.description: oauth | webhook when configured; null when disconnected

needsChannel.description: True when OAuth tokens exist but a Teams team/channel has not been chosen yet

toolEnabled.description: Whether workspace tool entitlement addons.teams is enabled

oauthAvailable.description: True when TEAMS_CLIENT_ID / TEAMS_CLIENT_SECRET are set on the server

authorizeUrl.description: Microsoft Entra authorize URL to open in the browser

incomingWebhookUrl.description: Microsoft Teams Incoming Webhook URL (outlook.office.com or webhook.office.com)
